sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to AFC Bridgnorth on Saturday for a 15:00 kick-off, looking to maintain their exceptional form. The visitors sit top of the table with 31 points from 13 games and have won four of their last five league matches, drawing the other. Bridgnorth, currently fifth with 24 points, will provide a stern test as they themselves have been consistent, though Sandbach's momentum makes them strong favourites.
divisionWide: Second-placed Bilston Town's recent loss means Sandbach has opened up clear daylight at the summit, though Bilston can close the gap slightly if they continue their winning run. Stafford Town, third with 25 points, host fourth-placed Shawbury United on Saturday—a fixture between upper-mid-table sides where Stafford's superior recent form (two wins in their last three) should give them the edge. Cheadle Heath Nomads (12th, 14 points) face Market Drayton Town (13th, 14 points) in a basement-area battle where neither side has found consistent form recently. Brereton Social, hovering near the bottom with 13 points, play Dawley Town (15th, 15 points) in another lower-table encounter. Foley Meir, with just 12 points, welcome struggling Widnes Town (bottom, 6 points) to what should be a tightly contested affair. On Tuesday evening, Telford Town (18th, 7 points) host Eccleshall (7th, 22 points)—a mismatch on paper as Eccleshall seek to consolidate their upper-half position against one of the division's weakest sides.
